ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models

2023

論文Paper · arXiv

呢篇論文提出推理同行動要交替進行。語言模型先寫低自己嘅思考，再決定調用邊個工具，然後讀取觀察結果，繼續下一步。後來好多 agent 框架都跟住呢個「諗、做、再諗」嘅循環。This paper argues that reasoning and acting should alternate. The language model writes down its thinking, chooses a tool, reads the observation, and continues. Many later agent frameworks follow this think, act, think loop.
